events.brand: White House Black Market × Saint Coffee
events.address: Saint Coffee, 201 7th Ave, New York, NY 10011
events.what_it_is: A one-morning NYFW stop with a preview of White House Black Market's fall collection at Saint Coffee.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise complimentary coffee and black-and-white cookies; NYC Plugged also advertises a signature WHBM shirt to take home, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Multiple current NYC event guides agree that this is open to the public. The shirt is reported by NYC Plugged but is not independently confirmed by an official WHBM page, so treat merchandise as inventory-dependent rather than guaranteed.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 8 AM–1 PM at Saint Coffee, 201 Seventh Avenue. No advance RSVP or organizer-approval requirement is published in the verified listings.

events.event_name: Ready, Set, Serve: A Tennis Fan Experience
events.address: The Shops at Skyview, 40-24 College Point Blvd, Flushing, NY 11354
events.what_it_is: A public tennis fan experience with an immersive photo booth and US Open finals livestreams, culminating in a September 13 celebration with a DJ, drinks and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: The official Skyview page advertises a free tennis photo booth and free tickets. The September 13 finale adds a live DJ, drinks and giveaways; exact giveaway inventory is not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The official page offers free tickets, but its extracted public page does not establish organizer approval. Treat registration as a free reservation path, not an approval request. The main giveaways and DJ programming are specifically advertised for September 13.
events.practical_notes: Finals screenings: September 11 at noon, September 12 at noon and 4 PM, and September 13 at 2 PM. The immersive tennis photo booth remains available through September 13.

events.what_it_is: A two-day public NYFW pop-up designed as a between-shows refresh stop with legwear, beauty touch-ups, coffee and content moments.
events.what_is_free: Current listings advertise free branded stickers, coffee beverages, hairstyle touch-ups, a photobooth and beauty sampling. Embroidery is free only with purchase of the specified Calzedonia knee highs.
events.caveats: Public-event sources agree on the location, dates and hours. Complimentary embroidery requires purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs; other samples and promotional items remain inventory-dependent.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 and Sunday, September 13 from noon–5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or organizer-approval requirement is published in the verified sources.
